classification_contract.ambiguous_blank_font_content: runtime tile bytes match only all-zero font sources and therefore do not identify a glyph
classification_contract.exact_nonblank_font_content: runtime 4bpp tile bytes exactly equal a nonblank ROM dialogue-font half expanded with the proven groups 2 or 3
classification_contract.ordered_sjis_vertical_pair: same-palette, unflipped vertical cells match half 0 then half 1 of one SJIS logical glyph
classification_contract.whole_bg_identity_policy: component matches never replace the parent layer's unidentified_runtime_payload classification
